title: Stopping processes using net stop
description: This query checks for attempts to stop at least 10 separate processes using the net stop command. Run query
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Process Name' = 'net.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*stop*') | timestats span = 2minute distinctcount('Command Line') as netStopCount, unique('Command Line') as NetStopList by Entity | where netStopCount > 10
